name: Hikikomori Sekai no Tantei Jikenbo #02 D.C. Shoushitsu Jiken
original_name: 引籠世界の探偵事件簿#02 D.C.消失事件
source:
Introduction is about a department store murder while main story is about disappearance on the island of Five Kingdoms. There are as many as 25 sites to conduct search, and protagonists from previous series join the search.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
开篇讲述百货商店的谋杀案，主线则围绕五王国岛上的失踪事件展开。岛上有多达25个地点可供调查，前作系列的主角们也会加入搜查。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
